title: Research on CAPTCHAs Targeted at AI: Human–Easy, Model–Hard Visual Tasks for the AI Era

contributions.purpose: 提出"AI难-人易"CAPTCHA设计空间与双通路假设
contributions.mechanism: 以"语言通路 vs 感知通路"框架设计5类极简视觉问答任务(尺寸/颜色 odd-one-out、组合干扰、数鸟腿/数手指)
contributions.evaluation: 定性框架 + 可复现任务生成脚本(5×5网格,RGB距离≈45)
contributions.domain: 多模态模型评测/CAPTCHA 安全
contributions.source_quote: we design five simple, highly intuitive visual question–answer tasks to systematically compare humans with leading multimodal models.

contributions.purpose: 量化人-模型在低层视觉任务的差距
contributions.mechanism: 5名人类 vs 5个主流VLM(GPT-5/Claude-Sonnet-4/Gemini2.5Pro/Doubao/Qwen2.5-VL),Fisher精确/卡方检验
contributions.evaluation: 尺寸任务人78% vs 模型≈5.6%(gap+72);组合任务人86% vs 模型0%(gap+86);数鸟腿16%/数手指21% vs 人94-98%;模型总体准确率17.6%-33.4%
contributions.source_quote: for size comparison and combined-difference tasks that require low-level visual perception, model accuracy collapses to near zero while humans perform almost perfectly.

contributions.purpose: 验证子假设 H1.1(人手 > 鸟腿)
contributions.mechanism: 对比反事实肢体计数任务的模型准确率
contributions.evaluation: 手指计数≈20.8% 略高于鸟腿≈15.6%,支持 H1.1
contributions.source_quote: models recognize abnormal human fingers slightly better than abnormal bird legs, supporting sub-hypothesis H1.1.

self_declared_provenance.quote: These findings align with evaluations reporting large human–model gaps on intuitive visual cognition [Schulze-Buschoff et al., 2024] and with visual-illusion CAPTCHAs that reliably trip models while remaining human-easy [Ding et al., 2025].

notes: reject。质量相对较高的实证论文,H1/H2/H1.1 三假设均获支持并有显著性检验。trade-off/局限(带数字):样本小——仅5名人类、5类任务各10题(50题),作者自认失败不代表普适缺陷,prompt工程/多轮澄清或改善结果。数据说明:刺激图为程序生成(A-C)或AI生成受控异常肢体(D-E),keys 自动记录并人工核验;因避免"种下长期CAPTCHA答案"而暂不开源(checklist Q5=No)。checklist AI 披露:各项均 B(mostly human);Writing=B(人主导,AI仅润色)。数据红旗:无明显造假,但 n=5 人类与每族10题的小样本使百分比精度有限。
